[package]
name = "http"
# When releasing to crates.io:
# - Update html_root_url in lib.rs.
# - Update CHANGELOG.md.
# - Create git tag
version = "1.5.0"
readme = "README.md"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/http"
repository = "https://github.com/hyperium/http"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = [
  "Alex Crichton <alex@alexcrichton.com>",
  "Carl Lerche <me@carllerche.com>",
  "Sean McArthur <sean@seanmonstar.com>",
]
description = """
A set of types for representing HTTP requests and responses.
"""
keywords = ["http"]
categories = ["web-programming"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.57.0"

[workspace]
members = [
  ".",
]
exclude = [
  "fuzz",
  "benches"
]

[features]
default = ["std"]
std = []

[dependencies]
bytes = "1"
itoa = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
quickcheck = "1"
rand = "0.10"
serde = "1.0"
serde_json = "1.0"
doc-comment = "0.3"

[package]
name = "benches"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2018"
publish = false

# `benches` is excluded from the root workspace, so declare an empty workspace
# table to let it build as a standalone package.
[workspace]

[dependencies]
bytes = "1"
fnv = "1.0.5"
itoa = "1"
http = { path = ".." }
indexmap = "<=1.8"
quickcheck = "0.9.0"
rand = "0.7.0"
seahash = "3.0.5"
serde = "1.0"
serde_json = "1.0"
criterion = "0.3.2"

[[bench]]
name = "header_map"
path = "src/header_map/mod.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "header_name"
path = "src/header_name.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "header_name2"
path = "src/header_name2.rs"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "header_value"
path = "src/header_value.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "method"
path = "src/method.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "uri"
path = "src/uri.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "opt_paths"
path = "src/opt_paths.rs"
harness = false

[package]
name = "http-fuzz"
version = "0.0.0"
authors = ["David Korczynski <david@adalogics.com>"]
publish = false
edition = "2018"

[package.metadata]
cargo-fuzz = true

[dependencies]
arbitrary = { version = "1",  features = ["derive"] }
libfuzzer-sys = { version = "0.4.0", features = ["arbitrary-derive"] }

[dependencies.http]
path = ".."

[[bin]]
name = "fuzz_http"
path = "src/fuzz_http.rs"

[workspace]

limitations: Explicit free-function paths, monomorphic inherent source candidates and bare generic-struct paths to unique concrete-specialization source candidates. Lifetime-only struct/enum owners additionally allow bare paths to unique receiver-free inherent declarations when unbounded impl lifetime names map one-to-one to owner arguments; unsupported siblings and enum variant names block selection. Specializations require named type arguments and no impl generics/where clause; competing unsupported inherent declarations block the candidate. No type/argument inference, visibility checking, Self/type-alias resolution, explicit generic call arguments, mixed lifetime/type parameters, concrete or bounded lifetime specializations, const/bounded/defaulted generic owners, receiver types beyond explicit parameters, adjacent-before-let bindings and trait objects, general macro expansion, build-script execution or external dependency source loading.

Cargo metadata reads captured manifests with zero-byte source inventory stubs, offline/no-deps/locked; the syntax parser reads captured source text only. Active cfg derives from rustc target cfg plus the declared local feature profile; custom build-script cfg stays unknown.

Call inventory covers parsed function/method bodies plus trait default method bodies, each once per source declaration; declarations without a body add no calls and calls depending on the concrete Self remain unresolved. A local macro_rules! invocation is traversed as its source argument expression only when the binding actually visible at the callsite (including a preceding block-local definition) is defined exactly once across the selected crates, is textually visible without an import or glob that could bind the same name, and every rule matches a single $x:expr used exactly once outside repetition and nested macro arguments under the active cfg; such calls carry macroEvidence. Other macros stay opaque records. Missing/excluded modules, conditional scopes and unsupported local items limit target/caller completeness.

outgoingImports.role: entry-file-wide source reading evidence, not selected-definition calls or execution timing

moduleReading.role: dependency reading locations, separate from calls; not proof of execution or affected behavior

base.unknown: Unresolved import destinations cannot be attributed to this entry. The count covers all captured sources, not potential consumers of this file.

head.unknown: Unresolved import destinations cannot be attributed to this entry. The count covers all captured sources, not potential consumers of this file.

moduleReading.factRole: Original records from this side/snapshot imports array. Preserve kind, typeOnly and lazy; absent typeOnly/lazy mean false. Use navigation.location only when valid.

limitations: File changes cover captured sources of the selected entry language only. Documents, excluded files and other languages are not checked; absence here is not evidence of no change. Definitions are selected only in the entry file; references search all captured files.

Unique file + qualified name + syntax kind slots pair reading locations, not persistent entities. Renames and moves are never inferred. Function text changes, including formatting, do not prove semantic change; identical text shifted in position is reported separately.

Known references are conservative source callsites, not runtime callers or complete/transitive impact. Dynamic dispatch, unsupported member calls, constructors and tagged templates remain outside binding coverage. Unresolved calls inside source ranges can include nested closures and owned decorators/headers. Python python-lexical-v1 targets ordinary undecorated module definitions or direct from-import aliases; v2 additionally follows one unique unconditional explicit reexport. Longer/rebound/conditional chains, decorated/method targets and runtime module initialization remain unsupported. Java v1 binds bounded same-file static source candidates; v2 additionally binds explicit class-qualified public static paths to captured top-level classes; v3 additionally distinguishes different fixed arities while same-arity/varargs competition, member dispatch and inherited owners remain unresolved. Go v1 binds captured free functions; v2 additionally follows compiler-selected concrete methods, including promotion, expressions and generic instances; v3 additionally binds interface method declarations captured in source as declaration anchors, while runtime interface dispatch and function variables remain unknown under incomplete external typing. Current Go change orientation additionally lists interface-mediated candidate callsites when captured go/types method sets prove that the changed concrete method is in an interface implementation; candidates are not definite runtime callers. Captures without interface implementation edges report interfaceCandidates as unavailable rather than zero. Argument type applicability and complete compilation are not checked. Historical unrecognized models remain unavailable with unknown totals.

Coordinates and factIndex belong to the named side/snapshot only. Original facts are captured evidence; use navigation.location only when valid. No whole-tree atomic capture or live re-resolution after capture is claimed.

Observed resolution settings include compiler options and actually read configuration/package contents. Differences conservatively limit binding attribution, even for irrelevant config text edits. Matching settings do not prove matching runtime environments; added source candidates can change resolution.
Every list is bounded with total/included/omitted. Git metadata is background; captured text and freshness checks establish source identity, including uncommitted edits.
